refnamediv.refpurpose: Import additional gpg public keys from kernel parameters or config file

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: rdii-pubkey-setup.service is a systemd service calling a script to parse a transient configuration file (/run/rdi-installer/rdii-config) and the Linux kernel command line (/proc/cmdline) at boot time.

rdi-installer verifies downloaded raw disk images with gpgv against the keyring /etc/systemd/import-pubring.gpg, which already contains the key used for the official repositories. If an image is signed with a different key, that key must be imported into the keyring first. This service allows doing so dynamically at boot via the rdii.pubkey parameter, without having to rebuild the installer image.

refsect1.title: Boot Parameters
refsect1.para: The service looks for the following parameter to import gpg public keys:

listitem.para: Format: HTTP(S)/FTP URL or Base64 Encoded

If the value starts with http://, https:// or ftp://, it is treated as the URL of an ASCII armored gpg public key, e.g. https://download.opensuse.org/repositories/devel:/microos:/images/Tumbleweed/repodata/repomd.xml.key. The key is downloaded and imported.
Otherwise the value is treated as a Base64 encoded ASCII armored gpg public key and decoded and imported directly, without any network access.
In both cases the key is added to the keyring /etc/systemd/import-pubring.gpg used by rdi-installer to verify downloaded images. rdii.pubkey may be specified more than once to import several keys.
The transient configuration file parsed by the script at boot.
The Linux kernel command line parsed for the parameter described above.
The gpg keyring the public key(s) are imported into.
